entries.land_location_as_stated: Situated on a large island in a small town off the coast of Maine; there is a lake near
entries.description: A seasonal guest house for lesbian women on an island in Stonington, Maine, run by two lesbian women and offering three rooms as a quiet retreat.
entries.raw_text: SEA GNOMES' HOME PO Box 33, Stonington, ME 04681 (207)367-5076. Womyn's Guest House offering 3 rooms at reasonable rates. Seasonal - June thru Sept. Situated on a large island in a small town off the coast of Maine. No bars, no TV, no swimming pool (though there is a lake near). Just a quiet retreat in a beautiful place. We are: 2 lesbians.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('Womyn's Guest House', 'quiet retreat'). Mailing address is a PO Box, but Stonington, ME is an island town matching 'Situated on a large island in a small town off the coast of Maine', so land_city and land_state are inferred from it. 'We are: 2 lesbians' is given without saying they live on the land, so num_residents is left blank. In 1986, 'Womyn's Guest House' and 'We are: 2 lesbians' give Lesbian women.

entries.land_location_as_stated: (Northport, ME); fields and woods in the heart of Mid-Coast Maine, where the mountains meet the sea; woods, farmland
entries.description: A year-round guest house on 18 acres of woods and farmland in Northport, Maine, with farm animals and gardens, where women live and work on the land. It is drug- and alcohol-free, offers lodging, meals, camping, and partial work exchange, and welcomes lesbian women and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: LAUREL RIDGE RFD 2 Box 277, Lincolnville, ME 04849 (207)338-1913 (Northport, ME). Laurel Ridge is a guest house for women on 18 beautiful acres of fields and woods in the heart of Mid-Coast Maine, where the mountains meet the sea. Our rates are very reasonable and our guests enjoy comfortable lodging and delicious home-cooked meals. There are domestic and farm animals about the place, as well as vegetable, herb, and flower gardens. Partial work exchange possible. Open year round. We welcome: non-lesbian women. No drugs or alcohol. We have/are: 18 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, farmland, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('Laurel Ridge is a guest house for women'). Rural route RFD 2 Box 277 gives land_street_address, land_state, and land_zip; '(Northport, ME)' gives the town the land is in for land_city. Women live on the land ('women living and working on the land'), but no resident count is given. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory) and Non-lesbian women ('We welcome: non-lesbian women'). Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('No drugs or alcohol') and Farming/self-sufficiency ('domestic and farm animals about the place, as well as vegetable, herb, and flower gardens', 'farmland').

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the Blue Mountains; in a private setting in the State Game Lands, one mile down from the Appalachian Trail and a short distance from Blue Marsh Recreation Area and PA Dutch country; woods
entries.description: A vacation cabin on 2 wooded acres in the Blue Mountains in Hamburg, Pennsylvania, run by two lesbian women. It offers rental accommodations and camping space, and welcomes new residents, lesbian women, non-lesbian women, girl and boy children, and gay and non-gay men.
entries.raw_text: HALF MOON PINES c/o Barbara Hart, RD #1 Box 1446, Hamburg, PA 19526 (215)373-5697. Vacation cabin in the Blue Mountains. 3-4 bedrooms which accommodate 7 persons, huge, cozy kitchen and enclosed porch. The cabin is in a private setting in the State Game Lands, one mile down from the Appalachian Trail and a short distance from Blue Marsh Recreation Area and PA Dutch country. Rates $225/week, $150/weekend, $50/day. We welcome: new residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 acres, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('Vacation cabin... Rates $225/week, $150/weekend, $50/day'). Rural route RD #1 Box 1446 gives land_* fields. 'We have/are: 2 lesbians' is given, but without saying they live on the land, so num_residents is left blank (and the two-woman rule would keep it from being Intentional Community even though it welcomes 'new residents'). Accepted groups from 'We welcome: new residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males': Lesbian women (questionnaire directory), Non-lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children, and Gay men + Non-gay men (from 'males').

entries.description: A lesbian residential community of 10 cottages with 15 resident lesbian women and a beachfront cultural and spiritual center in St. Augustine, Florida. Only lesbian women may rent or own cottages; the two-story center houses guest bedrooms, a feminist library, and a health food store, with no alcohol or smoking on the main floor, and welcomes new members and residents, girl children, and visiting non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: PAGODA 207 Coastal Hwy, St Augustine, FL 32084 (904)824-2970. We are a small lesbian residential community (10 separately owned cottages) with a cultural/spiritual center. Only lesbians can rent or own, but all wommin are welcome to become members and stay in one of our four bedrooms in the center as well as use our feminist library and health food store. Rules in our 2-story center: no smoking, no alcohol on main floor, no cooking or eating of meat, fish or fowl on main floor. We have a BBQ pit and flesh may be eaten elsewhere in building. No pets, no nudity on our property or directly in front of us on the beach. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women visitors. We have/are: 15 resident lesbians, 90 lesbian/nonlesbian members from all over the country, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, ocean, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('We are a small lesbian residential community (10 separately owned cottages) with a cultural/spiritual center', naming community first). Street address 207 Coastal Hwy gives land_* fields. num_residents is 15 ('15 resident lesbians, 90 lesbian/nonlesbian members from all over the country'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women, Girl children ('girl children'), and Non-lesbian women ('all wommin are welcome to become members and stay in one of our four bedrooms', 'nonlesbian women visitors'). Focuses: Lesbian separatism ('Only lesbians can rent or own' in the residential community), Spirituality/ritual ('cultural/spiritual center'), Archives/cultural work ('cultural/spiritual center', 'feminist library'), and Recovery/substance-free ('Rules in our 2-story center: no smoking, no alcohol on main floor').

entries.land_location_as_stated: (4115 M-22); in northwest Michigan a mile from Lake Michigan; among tall White Pine and Oak facing a sandy beach on Long Lake; woods
entries.description: A year-round wilderness resort of three cabins on 1 wooded acre on Long Lake in Honor, Michigan, where two lesbian women live and work on the land. The owners seek women to invest in nearby property to build an all-woman community with a lodge for workshops, and welcome new members and residents, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children under 12.
entries.raw_text: LABRYS c/o Nell Wagenaar & Rebecca Clark, Rt 1 Box 257, Honor, MI 49640 (616)882-5994 (4115 M-22). Labrys is an inexpensive, synergetic wilderness resort for women located in northwest Michigan a mile from Lake Michigan. We have three cabins nestled among tall White Pine and Oak facing a sandy beach on Long Lake with dock and boats. We are looking for women to invest in property here. Our dream is to make this end of Long Lake an all-woman community, with a possible campground, a quiet area for geese and heron nesting, more cabins and a community lodge for workshops, etc. Open year round. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children under 12, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 1 acre, 3 cabins, plumbing/electricity, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('Labrys is an inexpensive, synergetic wilderness resort for women'; also only 2 lesbians live there currently). Rural route Rt 1 Box 257, Honor, MI 49640 and the physical road address '(4115 M-22)' give the land location; 4115 M-22 is stored in land_street_address. num_residents is 2 ('2 lesbians... women living and working on the land'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), and Boy children ('boy children under 12'). Focuses: Workshops/education (plans 'a community lodge for workshops, etc.').

entries.land_location_as_stated: Located Rt 100 North of Kampsville, IL; scenic, secluded retreat for individuals and small groups by the Illinois River; woods
entries.description: A 14-acre wooded retreat by the Illinois River north of Kampsville, Illinois, where four lesbian women live part-time and work on the land. The proprietor offers groups and retreats, and the space welcomes new members and residents, lesbian women, non-lesbian women, girl and boy children, and gay and non-gay men.
entries.raw_text: RIVER SPIRIT RETREAT 187 W 19th St, Alton, IL 62002 (618)462-4051 or 653-4349 (retreat) or (314)773-3867 (St Louis). Located Rt 100 North of Kampsville, IL, 1 hr from Alton, 2 hrs from St Louis. River Spirit Retreat is a scenic, secluded retreat for individuals and small groups by the Illinois River. Retreat caters to women, especially lesbians. Open to alternative humanitarian types, counselors or small businesses needing retreat atmosphere. Proprietor is counselor and offers groups and retreats several times a year. We welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 14 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, camping space, women living part-time and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('RIVER SPIRIT RETREAT... River Spirit Retreat is a scenic, secluded retreat'). Mailing address is in Alton, IL, while the land is 'Located Rt 100 North of Kampsville, IL, 1 hr from Alton', giving land_street_address, land_city, and land_state. num_residents is 4 ('4 lesbians... women living part-time and working on the land', part-time). Accepted groups from 'We welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males': Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children, and Gay men + Non-gay men (from 'males').
